name: Hubert
source:
"After all you are just a prisoner. Even if you had a chance to escape you couldn't do anything."

The younger brother of the king of the Veke Kingdom. The protagonist's uncle and [url=/c45761]Henryk's[/url] father.
Aiming for the throne, he assassinates the king and queen.
He has no forgiveness for those that go against him and controls the kingdom with a reign of terror.
